fullData.title: Subtracting on a Number Line
fullData.subject: Arithmetic

problem.statement: Maya has 45 beads in her box. She uses 12 beads to make a bracelet. Use the number-line to start at 45 and count back by tens and ones to find how many beads Maya has left.

fullData.solutionStrategy: Split 12 into tens and ones, then count back in steps along the number line.

content.altText: A number line from 20 to 50 showing a backward jump of 10 from 45 to 35.

annotations.steps: Start at 45 on the number line and jump backward by 10 to land on 35.
annotations.strategy: I notice that subtracting a ten first makes the subtraction much easier to do in my head.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
annotations.connections: This builds on place value understanding by separating numbers into tens and ones.
annotations.narrative: Split $12$ into $1$ ten and $2$ ones, then jump back $10$ from the point Start@45 on the Figure 1 number line to reach the tick mark $35$ ($45 - 10 = 35$).

challenge.prompt: To subtract 12 from 45, Maya first jumps backward by 1 ten. What number does she land on?
challenge.rationale: Subtracting 1 ten from 45 moves backward 10 spaces to land on 35, rather than moving forward or counting the starting mark 45 as the first step.

content.altText: A number line from 30 to 50, showing a backward jump of 2 from 35 to 33.

annotations.steps: Count back 2 ones from 35 on the number line to land at 33.
annotations.strategy: I split 12 into a ten and ones so I can count back in easy steps.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
annotations.connections: Breaking numbers into tens and ones helps make subtraction much easier.
annotations.narrative: From $35$, count back $2$ ones to land at $33$ ($35 - 2 = 33$), meaning Maya has $33$ beads left.

specs.title: Jump back the ten
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Demonstrate how decomposing 12 allows taking an easy jump of 10 backward on the number line.
specs.seedNotes: Render a number line showing a start at 45 and a backward jump of 10 labeled -10 landing at 35, with decomposition 12 = 10 + 2 and equation 45 - 10 = 35.

specs.title: Count back the remaining ones
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Show how subtracting the remaining ones completes the decomposition to find the final total.
specs.seedNotes: Extend the number line visual from 35 with a backward jump of 2 units (or two -1 jumps) to land at 33, concluding with 35 - 2 = 33 beads.
